author: Grunter
what_it_is: First save in Seles. Dart with max XP and additions. Equipped with SoulEater, Legend Cascue, Red DG Armour, Bandit Boots, Therepy Ring. Also when his Dragon Stone is activated his Dragoon level will already be 5.
